item.title: Starling Bryant's legacy: Beyond championships in Buffalo
item.description: Starling Bryant, a Buffalo, N.Y. high school basketball coach, built a successful program on discipline and has won four state championships, 14 sectional titles, and is a New York State Basketball Hall of Fame inductee.
